// coding-misk · Ali di cenere
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(150/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 23], ['Crescendo 2', 52], ['Arpeggio', 4], ['Tema', 8], ['Strofa', 8], ['Pre', 4], ['Ritornello', 8], ['Assolo', 8], ['Ritornello finale', 8], ['Coda', 2]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 150, 'Crescendo 2': 150, 'Arpeggio': 150, 'Tema': 150, 'Strofa': 150, 'Pre': 150, 'Ritornello': 150, 'Assolo': 150, 'Ritornello finale': 150, 'Coda': 150}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!23 0!102>"  // Crescendo · 23 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm
const section2 = "<0!23 1!52 0!50>"  // Crescendo 2 · 52 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section3 = "<0!75 1!4 0!46>"  // Arpeggio · 4 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section4 = "<0!79 1!8 0!38>"  // Tema · 8 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section5 = "<0!87 1!8 0!30>"  // Strofa · 8 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section6 = "<0!95 1!4 0!26>"  // Pre · 4 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section7 = "<0!99 1!8 0!18>"  // Ritornello · 8 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section8 = "<0!107 1!8 0!10>"  // Assolo · 8 bars · 150 BPM · B · Bm G D A
const section9 = "<0!115 1!8 0!2>"  // Ritornello finale · 8 bars · 150 BPM · C · Cm G# D# A#
const section10 = "<0!123 1!2>"  // Coda · 2 bars · 150 BPM · C · Cm G# D# A#

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-23 · pattern A~3
// Drums · AkaiXR10
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.57).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.38).lpf(2000).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Crescendo 2 · bars 24-75 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.57).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.38).lpf(2000).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Tema · bars 80-87 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.57).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.38).lpf(2000).mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("cr").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<0!7 1>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
// Strofa · bars 88-95 · pattern B~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ [bd ~ ~ ~] ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.57).lpf(2000).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.38).lpf(2000).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("hats")

$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask("<1!2 [1 0] 1>").mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ ~ [sd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.57).lpf(2000).mask("<1!2 [1 0] 1>").mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.38).lpf(2000).mask("<1!2 [1 0] 1>").mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("hats")

$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("AkaiXR10").gain(0.76).lpf(2000).mask(section9).velocity(section9).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
